Your issue may already be reported!
Please search on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/jemise111/react-native-swipe-list-view/issues) before creating one.
Upgrading from v3? Check the [migration guide](https://github.com/jemise111/react-native-swipe-list-view/blob/master/docs/MIGRATION.md) first.

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior, ideally with a minimal code snippet
(the `SwipeListView` / `SwipeRow` props and `renderItem` / `renderHiddenItem` you use):

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen.

**Screenshots / logs**
If applicable, add screenshots, a screen recording, or console warnings/errors.

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Platform and OS version: [e.g. iOS 26.3 simulator, Android 16 device]
 - react-native-swipe-list-view: [e.g. 4.0.0]
 - react-native: [e.g. 0.86.3]
 - react-native-gesture-handler: [e.g. 2.32.0]
 - react-native-reanimated: [e.g. 4.5.1]
 - Expo SDK (if using Expo): [e.g. 57]
 - New Architecture enabled: [yes / no]
